% fancyvrb's \UseVerb with fvextra, whose inline commands take their own
% path: \SaveVerb and \UseVerb, with and without extra, \UseVerb*,
% \EscVerb, and \Verb, inline and in a heading, as in the PDF. In the PDF,
% fvextra's \UseVerb* shows no visible spaces.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fvextra}
\SaveVerb{head}|uvx-head_h|
\begin{document}
\SaveVerb{v}|uvx-text_a#b|
\SaveVerb{star}|uvx-star a  b|
Text \UseVerb{v} more.

\section{Head \UseVerb{head} end}

Plain \UseVerb[extra=false]{v} end.

Star \UseVerb*{star} end.

Escaped \EscVerb{uvx-esc\_e} end.

Verb \Verb|uvx-verb_v| end.
\end{document}
